decisions.statement: The keybinds file is named by the page property with the keybinds.
An akasha addon has its keybinds beside the page.
A game addon has its keybinds under a metadata folder.
An addon page claiming keybinds with no such file refuses the call.
A file the manifest names is looked for beside the page first.
A manifest name reaching nothing beside the page is looked for under metadata.
A manifest name reaching no file there reaches the page loaded by that name.
Markup and Lua are reached by one rule.
Two pages loaded by one name refuse the call.
A manifest name no page is loaded by refuses the call.
A page loaded by a name whose own file is absent refuses the call.

definition: where an addon's keybinds and named files are, whichever shape its folder takes
